command: import pathlib,json,hashlib; print(json.dumps({k:{'files':{p.relative_to(root).as_posix():hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()},'directories':sorted(p.relative_to(root).as_posix() for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_dir())} for k,root in {'home':pathlib.Path('/var/lib/tw-market/home'),'state':pathlib.Path('/var/lib/tw-market/state')}.items()}))
